sentences.text:
In the present case the tribunal awarded compensation under various heads as under:
 Sl.No. Heads. Amount in  (Rs.)
 1. Loss of dependency.
4,68,750  2. Funeral expenses & 20,000  transportation expenses.

3. Loss of love and affection @ 30,000 Rs.10,000/- each to P.1 to 3.
4.
Consortium to petitioner No.1.
5. Loss of estate Rs.10,000/- each 30,000 to P.1 to 3.
The tribunal has deducted 1/4th of the income towards personal and living expenses but it ought to have been 1/3rd, considering the family members are three in numbers.
Therefore, the compensation under the head loss of dependency is found to be more than actually what the claimants are entitled.
Under the other heads also the compensation awarded by the tribunal is found to be just and proper.
Therefore, by considering the overall facts of the case, the compensation awarded by the tribunal is found to be just and proper.

Hence it needs no NC:
2023:KHC-D:13273 interference.
Therefore the appeal is liable to be dismissed.

6. In the result, I proceed to pass the following:
ORDER i) The appeal is dismissed.
ii) The judgment and award dated 10.03.2020, passed by the Addl.
Senior Civil Judge & JMFC cum Member, MACT-VII, Hospete, in MVC No.291/2018, is confirmed.
iii) Send back the trial Court records along with a copy of this judgment.
iv) No order as to costs.

SD/-
